charge_port.notes: Estimated: BMW i7 uses CCS1 through 2026 (InsideEVs; BMW Canada: native NACS only on all-new 2026+ models). 2027 is the switch (BMW US). No page checked for a mid-2026 i7 NACS switch like the i5's.

supercharger_access.notes: Canada: Lectron Vortex Plus NACS-to-CCS adapter plus software update (from 2026-04-08).
US: Supercharging with a CCS-to-NACS adapter (Lectron) from the week of 2025-12-10 for i4/i5/i7/iX; 2026 cars need a software update.

wheels.notes: M70 Sedan: 21 x 9 front / 21 x 10.5 rear aluminum, P255/40R21 and P285/35R21; no optional wheels listed. US sizes from the Cars.com US page. Canada differs: NRCan rows in the merged data give 20 in standard (21 in option) for the Canadian car; Canadian sizes are not entered here (NRCan page not opened by me).
